title: The libsufr API changes planned for 0.8.0 land on dev
body:
`design/SOLUTIONS.md` on branch `design-goals` (2b3f8d9) lists planned changes to the libsufr public API, none of them started on `dev` at c97c6ae. Six of them break callers or change a public doc, so they land before 0.8.0:

| change | where |
|---|---|
| `Location` and `Extraction` are `#[non_exhaustive]` and keep their public fields | `libsufr/src/search.rs` |
| `Context` is removed, and `Hits::extract` takes `before: usize` and `after: Option<usize>` | `search.rs`, the CLI's `extract`, `libsufr/examples/search.rs`, the tests |
| `OpenOptions` has private fields and `with_` setters | `libsufr/src/lib.rs`, the CLI's `open_for_search` and `list` |
| `SuffixArray::text` returns `Cow<[u8]>`, borrowed when the text is in memory | `lib.rs`, `typed.rs` |
| `SuffixArrayBuilder::from_data` is public only under `unstable` | `libsufr/src/build.rs` |
| the doc of `max_query_len` says `Some(0)` means `None`, and that on a masked file it counts care positions | `lib.rs`, `TypedSuffixArray::open` |

## Out of scope

- The subsample cache, which waits on the decision in sufr-22b9c3.
- Iterators beside `Hits::suffixes`, `locate`, `extract` and `search_all`, which `SOLUTIONS.md` leaves to a later release.
close_reason: Landed on `dev` as 57d1235, one commit with all six changes and their `CHANGELOG.md` entries. The `--max-query-len` help text and `design/SOLUTIONS.md` remain as the earlier note describes.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/a9a34851
notes.text:
All six changes are in one commit, 57d1235 on branch `api-0.8-plan`, on top of `dev` at c97c6ae, with `CHANGELOG.md` updated to match. `cargo test --workspace --release` passes, and clippy shows only the two warnings `dev` already had. Not merged to `dev` yet.

Two details the plan left open:

- `OpenOptions` starts from `Default` and has no `new()`.
- Without `unstable`, the crate builds through `SuffixArrayBuilder::new`, which is `pub(crate)`, and `from_data` calls it.

The CLI's `--max-query-len` help still reads "Maximum query length", and says nothing about care positions or 0. `design/SOLUTIONS.md` on `design-goals` still lists these changes as not started.
